warnings: Several beam runs near the stair are printed with a compound label, e.g. 'B3X/B1(ชานพัก)' and 'B1/B2(ชานพัก)' — read as: the floor-2-level beam uses the first mark, and a SECOND beam at the stair-landing level (ชานพัก, roughly mid-height between floor1 and floor2) directly below/within the same plan footprint uses the second mark. Only the floor-2-level mark is recorded as the primary element below (matching this sheet's own level); the landing-level companion beam is noted in each affected element's 'note' field rather than duplicated as a second full element, since its own detailed position belongs to the stair sections (S-16/S-17).

The east 'S1' room is grid2-3 x row B to row B' — it does NOT reach row A, which is why no footing exists at 'A3' on either foundation plan. Re-read at high zoom 2026-08-26 after Makham flagged B4X as too long: B4X runs down grid3 from row B and stops after 0.90m on the room's south edge beam, and that edge beam then runs west to grid2. An earlier pass carried both members down to a '~A3' endpoint and gave B4X a 1.50m span. Both are now on the new dummy row B' (see grid master); nothing on this sheet sits at A3.

ROW D-C, partially re-read: the 2" beam (west edge of the S2 bay, centreline 4.70 east of grid1) was missing from an earlier pass and has been added, matching S-04/หน้า31. Two further items on this strip are measured but NOT yet applied here, pending Makham's review: (a) the beam recorded as 'D1-C1' scans at -1.00 (dummy 1', between the two CN2 tie-columns) with only a dash-dot centreline on grid1 itself, and the beam recorded as 'D3-C3' scans at 6.90 (dummy 3') with nothing on grid3 — the same two errors already corrected on S-04; (b) B6 sits at a different offset here than on S-04 (see its element flag).

'CN2' (small 0.20x0.20 tie-column, 4-Ø12mm) sits directly on grid D1/C1 with an X-hatch symbol, same treatment as 'CN1' on the floor-1 plan (S-04) — the same physical column continuing upward from floor2 to +6.65m (per S-13/หน้า40). Not re-listed as a separate plan element; see S-04's identical note.
'SP' direction-arrow markers again appear per room bay and are not itemized individually — see S-04's warning.
